- Version: 16.33.0, tarball sha512
  `z14u6A8ngAg9mgERRsNO8YkjIMefehIpBk7A8Dz3Gd91945qFP19MLPSHgV4z8P5u/MRYd5e07OTzaDoB4d6qA==`

icon files, not the trademarks. See docs/LICENSES.md.
